notes.title: Wormksull reaches 50 reviews!
notes.notes:
The second game of the studio has reached 50 reviews and I just want to thank everyone who has helped to make this possible.

I truly love making these games so it is such  a fulfilling feeling when you all enjoy these games!

50 reviews is a really unique milestone that I wanted to share and bring to everyones attention-
On a personal note Wormskull is in my top two of the games I've made. It is special to me.

Thank you again

Shane

notes.title: Demon Scrolls has arrived
notes.notes:
Hey everyone.
Demon Scrolls is the 9th title for Wolfs Moon Studios. 
We hope to see you all over there!

Wayland is sent from the west to try and help the town of Vormon with their goblin problem.
Before he knows it he is wrapped up in a much larger conflict.
A powerful wizard called the Primagen is attempting to piece together ancient scrolls
to summon a demon into the world. Join Wayland in his journey to stop the Primagen,
before the world is doomed.

Demon Scrolls is not attempting to reinvent the wheel.
This is a classic story with classic gameplay.
The game is straight forward and easy to comprehend.
If you enjoy killing monsters and finding treasure then this game
could be a good fit for you.
Players can expect over 20 hours of gameplay.
(Single Player RPG)

notes.title: 7th Wolfs Moon Title Seventh Star Released
notes.notes:
Is everyone ready for the next chapter for Wolfs Moon Studios?
Those who enjoyed Wormskull will recognize a few returning faces.

The war of the wolves continues to wage on for decades as the North and South struggle for power.
A young female warrior named Quarry fights for the southern kingdom of Rinehart.
She attempts to unite the southern hemisphere while uncovering her past.
What will she discover about the Seventh Star as she digs deeper? The people need hope and perhaps Quarry is exactly the person
to bring them it.

Players will enjoy a vibrant soundtrack, massive variety of monsters to encounter, an enjoyable story and engaging combat.
The option for crafting & alchemy is available for players who enjoy it in Seventh Star.
Similar to other Wolfs Moon Studios titles- players can expect many hours of game play and appearances from old and familiar faces from previous stories.
Single player RPG.

*Hundreds of monster types
*Unique Crafting/Alchemy recipes
*Engaging combat with multiple elements/status effects
*Over 20 hours of gameplay

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2240660/Seventh_Star/

notes.title: Wormskull sells over 1000 copies!
notes.notes:
Wormskull has now sold over 1000 copies.
This is a major milestone for Wormskull & the studio.

This game is so near and dear to me and to know that people feel the same way about it is such a special feeling.

I just wanted to take the time to thank everyone who has been on this journey with me.

Shane

notes.title: Dungeon Crawler Daniel has launched!
notes.notes:
Dungeon Crawler Daniel
Forsaken from his home...
Daniel must raise the money to buy it back from his ancestral birth givers.

Any adventurer that completes the Ravana Dungeon receives a massive pay out so Daniel goes on an adventure- but not before his parents cat Shana can hop in his backpack to tag along and annoy the everlasting heck out of Daniel.

Daniel & his familiar Shana must complete the dungeon to buy back his house!

Heroes from all timelines enter the fray
Join with them and descend the Ravana Dungeon.

Dungeon Crawler Daniel is a light hearted single-player RPG that has autosave & roguelike features where players can be removed by falling in combat.

There are A wide ensemble of monsters to face in the deepest levels of the dungeon.
Play any way that you wish....but in order to get the real gold you must complete the dungeon.

Average play time of 8-10 hours.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1664010/Dungeon_Crawler_Daniel

notes.title: Angel Made is off and running!
notes.notes:
Be sure to check out our new title: Angel Made


The latest title from Wolfs Moon Studios is Angel Made
It's included into the bundle pack to give returning customers/collectors a 25% discount!

Main Character Athos works for the church to perform exorcisms and save lost souls. His best friend Destiny teams up with him to correct the misdeeds of the world and try to make it a better place. The wicked ways of man quickly takes precedent as a struggle for power and control send Athos on a journey he never wanted.

Angel Made is a love story wrapped together tightly with conflict and drama. Emotional eunuch Athos displays the excitement of a stone when it comes to the interaction with his true love Destiny- that wears her heart on her sleeve. Fate pushes the two of them together and forces him to explore depths of himself he never knew he had.

*Massive Open world
*Vast story line
*Battle Intensive - but simple enough to understand
*Optional Quests
*Character Customization
*Trade skills: Mining, Crafting, Fishing, Alchemy
*Over 30 hours of game play
*Unique Veteran Experience that functions independently from standard experience to further customize characters
*Over 200 enemy types
*Over 75 musical themes
*Multiple Playable Characters
*Made by a Single Developer

notes.title: Verdungo coming August 31st
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378940/Verdungo

King Verdungo has been taken hostage and it's up to you to rescue him.
Travel across a diverse world to make your way back home, hopefully you arrive in time to save him before he meets an untimely demise.

Decide your party of four, choosing from classics such as Warrior, Cleric, Rogue, Paladin and Ninja- making up a total of 16 different playable classes.
In classic RPG fashion, players fight monsters, level up, and then are rewarded with points to spend to bolster the attributes of their characters.

Players will discover that gear can be crafted so you can create the ensemble that is just right for your play style.
Each class has their own set up of skills which make them unique, and skills will increase in power upon usage.

Along your journey to return home, players will encounter many NPC's which are in need of a heroes aid.
Different factions are at play and you never know if you're crossing paths with someone with ill intent or not!

It is up to you to decide who to help while making your journey back to rescue Verdungo.

* 15-20 hours of game play
* 75 different musical themes
* 150 different monster types throughout the world
* trade skills that can be utilized : Mining, Fishing, Crafting, Alchemy
* hundreds of crafting/alchemy recipes
* robust resource harvesting system that "regrows"
* open world where areas can be revisited (after tutorial)

notes.title: Wormskull receives positive rating
notes.notes:
[b]Wormskull has officially received a positive rating on Steam![/b]
We just wanted to take the time to thank all of you for making this possible!

Our [u]FIRST AND ONLY[/u] goal when we first started creating games, was to give the player a product that they  would connect with and enjoy!
A cast of characters to empathize with and appreciate.
Fun characters that are booming with personality & scenes that let you delve deeper into the minds and struggles of the heroes you have taken the guise of.

[u]We are thankful for every single person that makes a purchase, and your feedback is so important with pushing the game & franchise forward.[/u]

It isn't always the most enjoyable thing to sit down and write up a review for a game, but it means the world to us when you give us feedback and it also is incredibly helpful to others who are still undecided!

Everyone is encouraged to join in on the forums! Which characters did you feel resonate with you?
We can all relate to certain things, that is what makes us human!

[u]THank you all for everything and we look forward to hearing back from you in the future![/u]

Wolfs Moon Studios

notes.title: By popular demand, small updates coming!
notes.notes:
Players have pointed out they feel the "Blade of Learning" and "Elysian Cloak" take away much of the early game challenge, so because of your requests and thoughts, the items will be changed around a bit.

"Blade of Learning" will now be "Dagger of Learning" .....which is wearable by all.
"Elysian Cloak" will have life and mana slightly reduced to promote balance.

Instead of a limitless amount of the items which can be farmed,  now one of each will be located
in the Gnoll caverns!

Any other thoughts or concerns please post them in the forums!

Thank you!
